# Becky the Bat
> Free casual arcade flyer — iOS App Store and browser. Fly Becky across 100+ famous cities, dodge obstacles, collect hearts, chase distance.

- Site: https://beckythebat.com
- Get the app: https://beckythebat.com/app.html
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/becky-the-bat/id6803877783
- Play in browser: https://beckythebat.com/play.html
- Privacy: https://beckythebat.com/privacy.html
- Support: https://beckythebat.com/support.html

## Product facts
- Free to play (browser + App Store)
- Offline on iOS after install
- Optional one-time 100 Hearts IAP to continue after a crash — never required
- No ads, no subscription
- Category: Casual (secondary tip: Arcade)
- Privacy: Data Not Collected
